description: Use AI to break a broad task into 3-6 concrete, actionable subtasks. Claude analyses the task title and workflow context, then creates the subtasks automatically. Use when a task is too broad to complete in one step.

taskId.description: ID of the parent task to break down.

workflowId.description: Workflow ID that owns the task.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your configured workspace.

name: break_down_task
